values.note: Reserve by calling the Sand Hills State Forest office during office hours (Mon-Fri 8 am-noon, 12:30-4 pm), 843-498-6478; 'Campers must obtain a reservation ... in order to camp on the property.' A reservation runs 11 am to 11 am. Generators are allowed.

booking.source: https://www.scfc.gov/state-lands/sand-hills-state-forest/sand-hills-state-forest-campsite-information/ ('You must call the Sand Hills office during office hours to make camping reservations in order to camp on the property: (843) 498-6478'; 'Reservations run from 11 a.m. on day one until 11 a.m. the following day'; 'Generators ARE allowed at campsites') + https://www.scfc.gov/state-lands/sand-hills-state-forest/ (office hours), read 2026-10-21

values.note: A single primitive site beside Hunter Pond (Off TT 110 Rd.).
